🌦️ WEATHER UPDATE — Metro Manila | Wednesday, 2 September 2026

Current conditions: Light drizzle, 29.1°C (feels like 31.8°C), humidity 75%, winds 26.3 km/h with gusts up to 64.8 km/h.

Today's forecast: Thunderstorms expected, rainfall of about 17.5 mm, wind gusts up to 85.3 km/h, temperatures between 25.5°C and 30°C.

Severity: SEVERE — work from home where possible, avoid non-essential travel, and dress down in casual, weather-appropriate attire.
